       *still* important space avl"). Below md the labels are force-visible

       between md and xl they stay hidden (icon-only band), and at xl+ they
       show unless the measured overflow probe (bottom of the page) says the
       verbose locale does not fit. */
    @media (max-width: 767.98px) { #navbarSupportedContent .nav-label { display: inline !important; } }

       hides the labels again (icons + tooltips). */
    @media (min-width: 768px) { nav.navbar.nav-compact .nav-label { display: none !important; } }"

    <script>
      "(function () {
    /* R3-1b: MEASURED progressive collapse — the static xl breakpoint
       still overflows in verbose locales (labels + icons wider than the
       window → search box clipped, horizontal page scroll). Whenever the
       expanded bar does not fit, hide the labels (icons + tooltips);
       probe again when the window grows. */
    var navbar = document.querySelector('nav.navbar');
    if (!navbar) { return; }
    var lastW = 0;
    function fits() { return navbar.scrollWidth <= navbar.clientWidth + 1; }
    function apply() {
      var w = window.innerWidth;
      if (w < 768) { navbar.classList.remove('nav-compact'); lastW = w; return; }
      if (!navbar.classList.contains('nav-compact')) {
        if (!fits()) { navbar.classList.add('nav-compact'); }
      } else if (w > lastW) {
        navbar.classList.remove('nav-compact');
        if (!fits()) { navbar.classList.add('nav-compact'); }
      }
      lastW = w;
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', apply);
    window.addEventListener('load', apply);
    if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) { document.fonts.ready.then(apply); }
    apply();
  })();"
    </script>

      <style>
        "/* Feeding chip status dots (bugs.md U1) — bootstrap contextual palette. */
  .plan-dot-applied { color: #28a745; }
  .plan-dot-due { color: #007bff; }
  /* R4-7.14: this was amber (#e0a800) — the same colour as the "due now"
     tier it sits next to. Late is the only red in this palette, and the dot
     is the per-GROUP signal the tier header cannot give (one header, many
     groups), so it has to match the section the row is in. */
  .plan-dot-late { color: #dc3545; }
  .plan-dot-missing { color: #dc3545; }
  .plan-dot-scheduled { color: #6c757d; }
  .plan-dot-skipped, .plan-dot-deferred, .plan-dot-overridden { color: #6c757d; }
  .plan-feeding-chip { text-decoration: none; }
  .plan-feeding-chip:hover { text-decoration: none; background-color: #e2e6ea; }

  /* The three urgency sections are the screen's anchor targets (fix 2:
     late · now · later, always in this order) — offset the scroll so a
     jumped section is not hidden behind the fixed topbar. */
  #tier-late, #tier-now, #tier-later { scroll-margin-top: 60px; }

  /* R3-3/R3-4: each tier is ONE bordered, light-tinted section — header
     (tier name + count pill + chevron) and collapse body inside the same
     border, no more loose button toggles. Tints are the Bootstrap alert
     palette (late red · now yellow · later green). */
  .plan-tier { border: 1px solid; border-radius: 0.35rem; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; overflow: hidden; }
  .plan-tier-late  { background: #f8d7da; border-color: #f5c6cb; }
  .plan-tier-now   { background: #fff3cd; border-color: #ffeeba; }
  .plan-tier-later { background: #d4edda; border-color: #c3e6cb; }
  /* R9-2: the medication "Done" tier — same look as "Later" but a darker
     green so a finished series reads apart from the still-open later work. */
  .plan-tier-done  { background: #b7dfc2; border-color: #9fd0ae; }
  .plan-tier-done  .plan-tier-header { color: #0f4a1f; }
  .plan-tier-header {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; cursor: pointer; user-select: none;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .plan-tier-header .plan-tier-chevron { margin-left: auto; transition: transform 0.2s; }
  .plan-tier-header[aria-expanded="false"] .plan-tier-chevron { transform: rotate(-90deg); }
  .plan-tier-late  .plan-tier-header { color: #721c24; }
  .plan-tier-now   .plan-tier-header { color: #856404; }
  .plan-tier-later .plan-tier-header { color: #155724; }

  /* R4-7.14: the collapse body used to be forced to solid white, which
     painted a white table over the tier's own tint — a row in the "Late"
     section was as white as a row in "Later", so the colour carried no
     information at the row level, only at the border. Measured before:
     rowBg=rgba(0,0,0,0) inside paneBg=rgb(255,255,255).
     The body now inherits the tier tint, and the TABLE and its cells go
     transparent so nothing re-covers it. The tint stays a wash: the row text
     is dark on all three, so contrast is unchanged from the white body. */
  .plan-tier-body { background: transparent; }
  .plan-tier-body .table,
  .plan-tier-body .table tbody,
  .plan-tier-body .table td,
  .plan-tier-body .table th { background-color: transparent; }
  .plan-tier-body .table { margin-bottom: 0; }
  /* Bootstrap's hover on a tinted row is a grey wash that reads as dirt on
     red; a tint-preserving hover keeps the urgency readable while pointing. */
  .plan-tier-body .table-hover tbody tr:hover > td {
    background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45);
  }
  /* R4-7.14b/c: the due time is a sub-group LABEL, stated once, and a
     multi-animal row collapses behind a header that carries the count and the
     earliest time — so the closed state still says what is due rather than
     hiding it. */
  .plan-feed-animals { min-width: 12rem; }
  .plan-feed-header {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem;
    padding: 0.15rem 0; cursor: pointer; user-select: none;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }
  .plan-feed-header .plan-tier-chevron { margin-left: auto; transition: transform 0.2s; }
  .plan-feed-header[aria-expanded="false"] .plan-tier-chevron { transform: rotate(-90deg); }
  .plan-feed-count { font-weight: 600; }
  .plan-feed-when { color: #6c757d; }
  .plan-time-group { border-top: 1px dotted rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15); padding-top: 0.15rem; }
  .plan-time-group:first-child { border-top: 0; padding-top: 0; }
  .plan-time-label { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; color: #495057; }"
      </style>

                <span aria-hidden="true">
                  "×"
                </span>
              </button>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-body">
              <dl class="row mb-2">
                <dt class="col-sm-4">
                  "Animal"
                </dt>
                <dd class="col-sm-8" id="planApplyAnimal">
                </dd>
                <dt class="col-sm-4">
                  "Protocol"
                </dt>
                <dd class="col-sm-8">
                  <span id="planApplyDetail">
                  </span>
                  <br>
                  </br>
                  <small class="text-muted" id="planApplySource">
                  </small>
                </dd>
              </dl>
              <div class="alert alert-info small" id="planApplyExpect">
              </div>
              <div class="form-group d-none" id="planApplyAnswerGroup">
                <label for="planApplyAnswer">
                  "Answer"
                </label>
                <input autocomplete="off" class="form-control" id="planApplyAnswer" type="text">
                </input>
              </div>
              <div class="form-group d-none" id="planApplyWeightGroup">
                <label for="planApplyWeight">
                  "Weight (g)"
                </label>
                <input autocomplete="off" class="form-control" id="planApplyWeight" placeholder="850 g" type="text">
                </input>
              </div>
              <div class="form-group d-none" id="planApplyDosageGroup">
                <label for="planApplyDosage">
                  "Dosage"
                </label>
                <input autocomplete="off" class="form-control" id="planApplyDosage" placeholder="0.1 ml" type="text">
                </input>
              </div>
              <div class="form-group mb-0">
                <label for="planApplyNote">
                  "Note (optional)"
                </label>
                <input autocomplete="off" class="form-control" id="planApplyNote" type="text">
                </input>
              </div>
              <div class="alert alert-danger d-none mt-2 mb-0" id="planApplyError">
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-footer">
              <button class="btn btn-outline-secondary" data-dismiss="modal" type="button">
                "Cancel"
              </button>
              <button class="btn btn-success" id="planApplySubmit" type="button">
                "Confirm"
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div aria-hidden="true" class="modal fade" id="planDetailModal" role="dialog" tabindex="-1">

                  <span id="planDetailRemaining">

      <div aria-hidden="true" class="modal fade" id="planSkipDeferModal" role="dialog" tabindex="-1">
        <div class="modal-dialog" role="document">
          <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header">
              <h5 class="modal-title" id="planSkipDeferTitle">
              </h5>
              <button aria-label="Close" class="close" data-dismiss="modal" type="button">
                <span aria-hidden="true">
                  "×"
                </span>
              </button>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-body">
              <p class="text-muted small mb-2" id="planSkipDeferContext">
              </p>
              <div class="form-group">
                <label for="planSkipDeferReason">
                  "Reason (mandatory)"
                </label>
                <input autocomplete="off" class="form-control" id="planSkipDeferReason" type="text">
                </input>
              </div>
              <div class="form-group d-none" id="planSkipDeferHoursGroup">
                <label for="planSkipDeferHours">
                  "Defer by (hours)"
                </label>
                <input class="form-control" id="planSkipDeferHours" min="1" step="1" type="number" value="1">
                </input>
              </div>
              <div class="alert alert-danger d-none" id="planSkipDeferError">
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-footer">
              <button class="btn btn-primary" id="planSkipDeferSubmit" type="button">
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div aria-hidden="true" class="modal fade" id="planDosageModal" role="dialog" tabindex="-1">
        <div class="modal-dialog" role="document">
          <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header">
              <h5 class="modal-title">
                "Dosage cannot be computed automatically"
              </h5>
              <button aria-label="Close" class="close" data-dismiss="modal" type="button">
                <span aria-hidden="true">
                  "×"
                </span>
              </button>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-body">
              <div class="alert alert-warning" id="planDosageDetail">
              </div>
              <p class="text-muted d-none" id="planDosageWeight">
              </p>
              <input autocomplete="off" class="form-control" id="planDosageInput" placeholder="0.1 ml" type="text">
              </input>
              <div class="alert alert-danger d-none mt-2" id="planDosageError">
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-footer">
              <button class="btn btn-primary" id="planDosageSubmit" type="button">
                "Apply with this dosage"
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div aria-hidden="true" class="modal fade" id="planMessageModal" role="dialog" tabindex="-1">
        <div class="modal-dialog" role="document">
          <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header">
              <h5 class="modal-title" id="planMessageTitle">
              </h5>
              <button aria-label="Close" class="close" data-dismiss="modal" type="button">
                <span aria-hidden="true">
                  "×"
                </span>
              </button>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-body">
              <pre class="mb-0" id="planMessageBody" style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-family:inherit;">
              </pre>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-footer">
              <button class="btn btn-primary" data-dismiss="modal" type="button">
                "OK"
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <script>
        "(function () {
  // R4-4.1 (shared): every action announces itself so a page with the
  // auto-refresh timer holds the reload off for the visibility floor.
  var ACTION_VISIBILITY_MS = 30000;
  var lastActionAt = 0;
  function markAction() { lastActionAt = Date.now(); }
  window.planMarkAction = markAction;

  var inFlight = 0;
  function track(p) {
    inFlight++;
    return p.then(function (v) { inFlight--; return v; }, function (e) { inFlight--; throw e; });
  }
  function busy() { return inFlight > 0; }
  var csrf = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]').content;
  // {ref, btn} awaiting a manual dosage (§10-B6); btn is flipped in place
  // once the dosage is recorded (R5-2c: no full reload).
  var pending = null;
  // §6.2-2 (A1): recording a clearly late occurrence is an explicit act —
  // one confirm, once, before the POST.
  var lateConfirm = "Record this missed occurrence after the fact?";
  function lateBlocked(btn) {
    return btn.getAttribute('data-late') === 'true' && !window.confirm(lateConfirm);
  }
  var i18n = {
    errorTitle: "Something went wrong",
    expect: {
      feeding:    "The feeding will be recorded as done and the entry will be marked as applied.",
      medication: "The treatment will be marked as given for this slot. You can undo it if needed.",
      care:       "The care will be recorded and the entry will be marked as applied.",
      cleanup:    "The cleaning will be recorded and the entry will be marked as applied.",
      weighing:   "The weighing will be recorded with the weight below.",
      observation:"The observation answer will be recorded. An alert answer creates a warning care and a follow-up plan."
    },
    answerRequired: "An answer is required for an observation.",
    weightRequired: "A weight is required for a weighing.",
    status: {
      scheduled: "Scheduled",
      due:       "Due",
      late:      "Late",
      missing:   "Missing",
      applied:   "Done",
      skipped:   "Skipped",
      deferred:  "Deferred",
      overridden:"Replaced by animal protocol"
    },
    kinds: {
      feeding:    "Feeding",
      medication: "Medication",
      care:       "Care",
      cleanup:    "Cleanup",
      weighing:   "Weighing",
      observation:"Observation"
    },
    batchSummary: "You are about to mark {count} entry(ies) for cage {cage} ({what}) as applied."
  };

  function showMessage(title, body) {
    document.getElementById('planMessageTitle').textContent = title;
    document.getElementById('planMessageBody').textContent = body;
    $('#planMessageModal').modal('show');
  }

  function applyItem(ref, extra) {
    var body = {
      source_type: ref.sourceType, source_id: ref.sourceId,
      animal_id: ref.animalId, due_at: ref.dueAt
    };
    if (extra) {
      Object.keys(extra).forEach(function (k) { if (extra[k]) { body[k] = extra[k]; } });
    }
    return track(fetch('/care_plan/apply', {
      method: 'POST', credentials: 'same-origin',
      headers: {'Accept': 'application/json', 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRF-Token': csrf},
      body: JSON.stringify(body)
    }).then(function (r) {
      return r.json().then(function (j) { return {status: r.status, body: j}; });
    }));
  }

  function showDosageDialog(ref, warn, btn) {
    pending = {ref: ref, btn: btn || null};
    document.getElementById('planDosageDetail').textContent = warn.detail || '';
    var wBox = document.getElementById('planDosageWeight');
    if (warn.last_weight) {
      var when = (warn.last_weight_at || '').slice(0, 10);
      wBox.textContent = "Last recorded weight" + ": " + warn.last_weight + " g (" + when + ")";
      wBox.classList.remove('d-none');
    } else {
      wBox.classList.add('d-none');
    }
    document.getElementById('planDosageInput').value = '';
    document.getElementById('planDosageError').classList.add('d-none');
    $('#planDosageModal').modal('show');
  }

  // --- One-toggle apply/unapply (bugs.md R5-2c, D-a) -----------------------
  // ONE policy for dashboard AND work screen: confirm only when fields are
  // needed (weighing → weight, observation → answer); everything else
  // toggles INSTANTLY — no confirm, no reload. The button flips in place;
  // the view link is a sibling that never moves. Medication dosage stays
  // optional: a 422 dosage_required opens the dosage dialog.
  var applyRef = null;

  function openApply(btn) {
    applyRef = {
      btn: btn,
      sourceType: btn.getAttribute('data-source-type'),
      sourceId: btn.getAttribute('data-source-id'),
      animalId: parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-animal-id'), 10),
      dueAt: btn.getAttribute('data-due-at'),
      kind: btn.getAttribute('data-kind')
    };
    document.getElementById('planApplyAnimal').textContent = btn.getAttribute('data-animal-label') || '';
    document.getElementById('planApplyDetail').textContent = btn.getAttribute('data-detail') || '';
    document.getElementById('planApplySource').textContent = btn.getAttribute('data-source-name') || '';
    document.getElementById('planApplyExpect').textContent = i18n.expect[applyRef.kind] || '';
    document.getElementById('planApplyAnswerGroup').classList.toggle('d-none', applyRef.kind !== 'observation');
    document.getElementById('planApplyWeightGroup').classList.toggle('d-none', applyRef.kind !== 'weighing');
    document.getElementById('planApplyDosageGroup').classList.toggle('d-none', applyRef.kind !== 'medication');
    applyRef.late = btn.classList.contains('plan-late-btn');
    document.getElementById('planApplyAnswer').value = '';
    document.getElementById('planApplyWeight').value = '';
    document.getElementById('planApplyDosage').value = '';
    document.getElementById('planApplyNote').value = '';
    document.getElementById('planApplyError').classList.add('d-none');
    $('#planApplyModal').modal('show');
  }

  // One-toggle dispatch (D-a): input kinds open the modal, everything
  // else applies instantly and flips the button in place.
  //
  // R4-2.2: a FEEDING entry rendered on an animal tab (class
  // plan-feeding-entry) is an input kind too — the caregiver confirms the
  // ration in the prefilled modal instead of a bare instant click.
  function isInputKind(btn) {
    var kind = btn.getAttribute('data-kind');
    if (kind === 'weighing' || kind === 'observation') { return true; }
    return kind === 'feeding' && btn.classList.contains('plan-feeding-entry');
  }

  // R3-2: one row = one toggle pair — the apply check (`.plan-apply-btn` /
  // `.plan-feeding-one`) and its undo sibling (`.plan-unapply-btn`) swap
  // visibility in place; no reload, no waiting for the auto-refresh.
  function pairApply(btn) { return btn.parentNode.querySelector('.plan-apply-btn, .plan-feeding-one'); }
  function pairUndo(btn) { return btn.parentNode.querySelector('.plan-unapply-btn'); }

  // markApplied flips an apply check to its undo control IN PLACE (R3-2):
  // check hides, undo shows; the next full render (auto-refresh) moves
  // the row to its tier/history. Shim over setToggleState (Phase 0b t7).
  function markApplied(ref) {
    markAction();
    setToggleState(ref && ref.btn, true);
  }

  // markOpen flips an applied row back to its apply check (undo clicked).
  function markOpen(ref) {
    markAction();
    setToggleState(ref && ref.btn, false);
  }

  // setToggleState (Phase 0b t7): THE single toggle-flip routine. ONE
  // place owns how a toggle button looks in its applied vs open state —
  // every page that flips a toggle calls this (directly or via the
  // markApplied/markOpen shims below).
  //
  // Two button families:
  //   med slot (`.plan-med-slot`) — ONE button stays live; applied ↔ open
  //     swaps its classes/glyph in place. Colour comes from the button's
  //     own data-tier-class (R4-1.1), so an unapplied late slot returns to
  //     its tier colour instead of a hardcoded yellow.
  //   pair rows (`.plan-apply-btn` / `.plan-feeding-one` ↔ `.plan-unapply-btn`)
  //     — two sibling buttons swap visibility; the applied state also tints
  //     the enclosing `.plan-animal-row` (R9-1).
  function setToggleState(btn, applied) {
    if (!btn) { return; }
    if (btn.classList.contains('plan-med-slot')) {
      var hm = btn.textContent.replace('○', '').replace('✓', '')
        .replace('–', '').replace('⊘', '').replace('⏸', '').trim();
      if (applied) {
        btn.classList.remove('btn-warning', 'btn-danger', 'btn-light', 'border',
          'plan-med-apply', 'plan-med-urgent', 'plan-med-future');
        btn.classList.add('btn-success', 'plan-med-unapply');
        btn.textContent = '✓ ' + hm;
      } else {
        btn.classList.remove('btn-success', 'plan-med-unapply');
        var tier = btn.getAttribute('data-tier-class') || 'btn-warning';
        tier.split(/\s+/).forEach(function (c) { if (c) { btn.classList.add(c); } });
        btn.classList.add('plan-med-apply');
        btn.textContent = '○ ' + hm;
      }
      btn.disabled = false;
      return;
    }
    // Pair rows: visibility swap + IMMEDIATE colour flip (§2.2, Phase 4 /
    // D4). The apply/undo pair both carry data-tier-class (the
    // occurrence's CURRENT tier colour, §2.4): apply paints the visible
    // undo green (btn-success — done), undo restores the apply's tier
    // colour (which may differ from the colour it had before applying —
    // §2.2). Feeding/cleanup rows (`.plan-animal-row`) keep their R9-1
    // applied tint; those buttons carry no data-tier-class, so their
    // colour is untouched.
    markAction();
    btn.classList.add('d-none');
    btn.disabled = false;
    var sib = applied ? pairUndo(btn) : pairApply(btn);
    if (sib) {
      sib.classList.remove('d-none');
      var tier = sib.getAttribute('data-tier-class');
      if (tier) {
        sib.classList.remove('btn-danger', 'btn-warning', 'btn-light', 'border', 'btn-success');
        if (applied) {
          sib.classList.add('btn-success');
        } else {
          tier.split(/\s+/).forEach(function (c) { if (c) { sib.classList.add(c); } });
        }
      }
    }
    var row = btn.closest ? btn.closest('.plan-animal-row') : null;
    if (row) { row.classList.toggle('plan-animal-applied', !!applied); }
  }
  window.planSetToggleState = setToggleState;

  // Delegated (R4-2.2): one listener covers every page that includes this
  // partial — the work screen, the dashboard and the animal tabs — and
  // buttons rendered later by another script.
  document.addEventListener('click', function (ev) {
    var btn = ev.target.closest ? ev.target.closest('.plan-apply-btn, .plan-feeding-one') : null;
    if (!btn || btn.disabled) { return; }
    if (lateBlocked(btn)) { return; }
    if (isInputKind(btn)) { openApply(btn); return; }
    instantApply(btn);
  });

  function instantApply(btn) {
    markAction();
    var ref = btnRef(btn);
    btn.disabled = true;
    applyItem(ref).then(function (res) {
      if (res.status === 201) { markApplied(ref); return; }
      btn.disabled = false;
      if (res.status === 422 && res.body && res.body.error === 'dosage_required') {
        showDosageDialog(ref, res.body, btn);
        return;
      }
      showMessage(i18n.errorTitle, (res.body && (res.body.detail || res.body.error)) || ('HTTP ' + res.status));
    });
  }

  // In-place undo (R3-2): same /care_plan/unapply call as the history
  // undo, but flips the row's toggle back instead of reloading.
  document.addEventListener('click', function (ev) {
    var btn = ev.target.closest ? ev.target.closest('.plan-unapply-btn') : null;
    if (!btn || btn.disabled) { return; }
    instantUnapply(btn);
  });

  function instantUnapply(btn) {
    markAction();
    var ref = btnRef(btn);
    btn.disabled = true;
    track(fetch('/care_plan/unapply', {
      method: 'POST', credentials: 'same-origin',
      headers: {'Accept': 'application/json', 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRF-Token': csrf},
      body: JSON.stringify({
        source_type: ref.sourceType, source_id: ref.sourceId,
        animal_id: ref.animalId, due_at: ref.dueAt,
        delete_fulfillment: true
      })
    })).then(function (r) {
      if (r.status === 200) { markOpen(ref); return; }
      btn.disabled = false;
      r.json().then(function (j) {
        showMessage(i18n.errorTitle, (j && (j.detail || j.error)) || ('HTTP ' + r.status));
      });
    });
  }

  function btnRef(btn) {
    return {
      btn: btn,
      sourceType: btn.getAttribute('data-source-type'),
      sourceId: btn.getAttribute('data-source-id'),
      animalId: parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-animal-id'), 10),
      dueAt: btn.getAttribute('data-due-at'),
      kind: btn.getAttribute('data-kind'),
      hm: btn.textContent.replace('○', '').replace('✓', '').replace('–', '').replace('⊘', '').replace('⏸', '').trim()
    };
  }

  document.getElementById('planApplySubmit').addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (!applyRef) { return; }
    var errBox = document.getElementById('planApplyError');
    var extra = { note: document.getElementById('planApplyNote').value.trim() };
    if (applyRef.kind === 'observation') {
      extra.answer = document.getElementById('planApplyAnswer').value.trim();
      if (!extra.answer) {
        errBox.textContent = i18n.answerRequired;
        errBox.classList.remove('d-none');
        return;
      }
    }
    if (applyRef.kind === 'weighing') {
      extra.weight = document.getElementById('planApplyWeight').value.trim();
      if (!extra.weight) {
        errBox.textContent = i18n.weightRequired;
        errBox.classList.remove('d-none');
        return;
      }
    }
    if (applyRef.late) { extra.late = true; }
    if (applyRef.kind === 'medication') {
      extra.dosage = document.getElementById('planApplyDosage').value.trim();
    }
    var ref = applyRef;
    this.disabled = true;
    var submitBtn = this;
    applyItem(ref, extra).then(function (res) {
      submitBtn.disabled = false;
      if (res.status === 201) {
        // R5-2c: no reload — flip the originating button in place.
        $('#planApplyModal').modal('hide');
        markApplied(ref);
        return;
      }
      $('#planApplyModal').modal('hide');
      if (res.status === 422 && res.body && res.body.error === 'dosage_required') {
        showDosageDialog(ref, res.body, ref.btn);
        return;
      }
      showMessage(i18n.errorTitle, (res.body && (res.body.detail || res.body.error)) || ('HTTP ' + res.status));
    });
  });

  // --- Skip / defer -----------------------------------------------------------
  // Shared skip/defer modal (§7.3.1): skip = reason only; defer = reason +
  // hours (default +1h, §10-L3 → RFC3339 now+Nh). Empty reason stays
  // client-side — the server enforces 422 too (§10-CP4).
  var sdRef = null;
  var sdMode = 'skip';
  var sdLabels = {
    skip: {title: "Skip this occurrence", submit: "Skip"},
    defer: {title: "Defer this occurrence", submit: "Defer"}
  };

  function openSkipDefer(btn) {
    sdMode = btn.getAttribute('data-mode');
    sdRef = {
      sourceType: btn.getAttribute('data-source-type'),
      sourceId: btn.getAttribute('data-source-id'),
      animalId: parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-animal-id'), 10),
      dueAt: btn.getAttribute('data-due-at')
    };
    document.getElementById('planSkipDeferTitle').textContent = sdLabels[sdMode].title;
    document.getElementById('planSkipDeferSubmit').textContent = sdLabels[sdMode].submit;
    document.getElementById('planSkipDeferContext').textContent =
      (btn.getAttribute('data-animal-label') || '') + (btn.getAttribute('data-detail') ? ' — ' + btn.getAttribute('data-detail') : '');
    document.getElementById('planSkipDeferReason').value = '';
    document.getElementById('planSkipDeferHours').value = 1;
    document.getElementById('planSkipDeferError').classList.add('d-none');
    document.getElementById('planSkipDeferHoursGroup').classList.toggle('d-none', sdMode !== 'defer');
    $('#planSkipDeferModal').modal('show');
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', function (ev) {
    var btn = ev.target.closest ? ev.target.closest('.plan-skip-btn, .plan-defer-btn') : null;
    if (!btn) { return; }
    openSkipDefer(btn);
  });

  document.getElementById('planSkipDeferSubmit').addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (!sdRef) { return; }
    var reason = document.getElementById('planSkipDeferReason').value.trim();
    var errBox = document.getElementById('planSkipDeferError');
    if (!reason) {
      errBox.textContent = "A reason is mandatory";
      errBox.classList.remove('d-none');
      return;
    }
    var body = {
      source_type: sdRef.sourceType, source_id: sdRef.sourceId,
      animal_id: sdRef.animalId, due_at: sdRef.dueAt,
      status: sdMode === 'defer' ? 'deferred' : 'skipped',
      note: reason
    };
    if (sdMode === 'defer') {
      var hours = parseInt(document.getElementById('planSkipDeferHours').value, 10);
      if (!hours || hours < 1) { hours = 1; }
      body.deferred_until = new Date(Date.now() + hours * 3600000).toISOString();
    }
    fetch('/care_plan/apply', {
      method: 'POST', credentials: 'same-origin',
      headers: {'Accept': 'application/json', 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRF-Token': csrf},
      body: JSON.stringify(body)
    }).then(function (r) {
      if (r.status === 201) { window.location.reload(); return; }
      r.json().then(function (j) {
        errBox.textContent = (j && (j.detail || j.error)) || ('HTTP ' + r.status);
        errBox.classList.remove('d-none');
      });
    });
  });

  document.getElementById('planDosageSubmit').addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (!pending) { return; }
    var dosage = document.getElementById('planDosageInput').value.trim();
    if (!dosage) { return; }
    var ref = pending.ref;
    applyItem(ref, {dosage: dosage}).then(function (res) {
      if (res.status === 201) {
        // R5-2c: no reload — flip the originating button in place.
        $('#planDosageModal').modal('hide');
        if (ref.btn) { markApplied(ref); } else { window.location.reload(); }
        return;
      }
      var box = document.getElementById('planDosageError');
      box.textContent = (res.body && (res.body.detail || res.body.error)) || ('HTTP ' + res.status);
      box.classList.remove('d-none');
    });
  });


  // Phase 1 / D1 (guideline §5 level 2 + §6.2): bucket-fit pass over the
  // medication button groups. CSS alone cannot know whether a series
  // FITS on one row, so this measures after layout:
  //   - a group whose buttons wrapped onto several rows is STACKED: it
  //     gets .plan-med-btns--stacked (full-width row under the label,
  //     right-aligned) and its .plan-med-bucket captions stay visible —
  //     the labelled band between the button rows;
  //   - a group that fits one row keeps shape A and its captions are
  //     HIDDEN (the slot title already carries the bucket name) — the
  //     caption never sits inline between two buttons of the same row.
  // No-JS fallback: captions render visible and each forces its own row
  // (flex-basis 100%), so the inline-caption defect cannot reappear.
  function fitMedBuckets() {
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.plan-med-btns'), function (g) {
      var buckets = g.querySelectorAll('.plan-med-bucket');
      if (!buckets.length) { return; }
      g.classList.remove('plan-med-btns--stacked');
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(buckets, function (b) { b.classList.add('d-none'); });
      var cells = g.querySelectorAll('.plan-med-cell');
      var tops = {};
      var rows = 0;
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(cells, function (c) {
        var y = c.offsetTop;
        if (!tops[y]) { tops[y] = true; rows++; }
      });
      if (rows > 1) {
        g.classList.add('plan-med-btns--stacked');
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(buckets, function (b) { b.classList.remove('d-none'); });
      }
    });
  }
  var fitBucketsTimer = null;
  function scheduleFitMedBuckets() {
    if (fitBucketsTimer) { clearTimeout(fitBucketsTimer); }
    fitBucketsTimer = setTimeout(fitMedBuckets, 120);
  }
  window.addEventListener('load', fitMedBuckets);
  window.addEventListener('resize', scheduleFitMedBuckets);
  // A tier collapse/expand re-flows every group inside it (Bootstrap
  // slides over ~350 ms — re-measure once it settles).
  document.addEventListener('click', function (ev) {
    var h = ev.target.closest ? ev.target.closest('.plan-tier-header[data-toggle="collapse"]') : null;
    if (h) { setTimeout(fitMedBuckets, 400); }
  });

  // R4-4.1: the age of the last action, for a page's auto-refresh guard.
  window.planActionAge = function () { return Date.now() - lastActionAt; };
  // R4-2.2: pages that still own page-specific scripts (batch apply,
  // detail popup, history) reuse these instead of re-implementing them.
  window.planApply = {
    csrf: csrf, i18n: i18n, track: track, busy: busy,
    applyItem: applyItem, showMessage: showMessage, markApplied: markApplied,
    markAction: markAction, setToggleState: setToggleState,
    pending: function () { return pending; }
  };
})();"

      <div aria-hidden="true" class="modal fade" id="planBatchModal" role="dialog" tabindex="-1">

      <script>
        "(function () {
  // Auto-refresh (§10-CP6c): reload every 60 s unless a modal is open OR a
  // request is still in flight — refreshing away an in-progress dosage
  // entry or a just-sent apply would lose work (round-2 §7.3).
  // R4-4.1: a change the caregiver just made must stay visible long enough
  // to be SEEN. The old single 60 s timer armed at page load meant an
  // apply at T=59 s was wiped by the reload one second later. Every action
  // records its time in the SHARED apply partial; the refresh defers
  // itself while the page was changed less than 30 s ago (the requested
  // floor). One 5 s interval checks the due time — no chained setTimeout,
  // no drift.
  var RELOAD_PERIOD_MS = 60000;
  var TICK_MS = 5000;
  var nextReloadAt = Date.now() + RELOAD_PERIOD_MS;
  var csrf = planApply.csrf;
  var i18n = planApply.i18n;
  var track = planApply.track;
  var showMessage = planApply.showMessage;
  var markApplied = planApply.markApplied;
  var applyItem = planApply.applyItem;

  function scheduleReload() {
    setInterval(function () {
      if (Date.now() < nextReloadAt) { return; }              // not due yet
      if (window.planActionAge() < 30000) { return; } // R4-4.1 floor
      if (jQuery('.modal').is(':visible') || planApply.busy()) { return; }
      window.location.reload();
    }, TICK_MS);
  }
  scheduleReload();

  // R3-4: tier headers are divs (not buttons) — give them keyboard
  // collapse toggling (Enter/Space) to match the click affordance.
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.plan-tier-header[data-toggle="collapse"]'), function (h) {
    h.addEventListener('keydown', function (ev) {
      if (ev.key === 'Enter' || ev.key === ' ') { ev.preventDefault(); jQuery(h).trigger('click'); }
    });
  });

  // --- Detail popup (read-only, shared partial) -----------------------------
  // Rev: one filler shared by the ℹ buttons AND the feeding rows (the row
  // is the click affordance there — the ration text and times only live in
  // this modal).
  function fillPlanDetail(el) {
    document.getElementById('planDetailAnimal').textContent = el.getAttribute('data-animal-label') || '—';
    var aLink = document.getElementById('planDetailAnimalLink');
    if (el.getAttribute('data-animal-link')) { aLink.setAttribute('href', el.getAttribute('data-animal-link')); aLink.classList.remove('d-none'); }
    else { aLink.classList.add('d-none'); }
    document.getElementById('planDetailDetail').textContent = el.getAttribute('data-detail') || '—';
    document.getElementById('planDetailSource').textContent = el.getAttribute('data-source-name') || '—';
    var sLink = document.getElementById('planDetailSourceLink');
    if (el.getAttribute('data-source-link')) { sLink.setAttribute('href', el.getAttribute('data-source-link')); sLink.classList.remove('d-none'); }
    else { sLink.classList.add('d-none'); }
    // R9-2: direct treatment link (record when applied, else Treatment tab).
    var tLink = el.getAttribute('data-treatment-link');
    document.getElementById('planDetailTreatmentDt').classList.toggle('d-none', !tLink);
    document.getElementById('planDetailTreatmentDd').classList.toggle('d-none', !tLink);
    if (tLink) {
      document.getElementById('planDetailTreatmentLink').setAttribute('href', tLink);
      document.getElementById('planDetailTreatment').textContent = el.getAttribute('data-detail') || tLink;
    }
    document.getElementById('planDetailKind').textContent = i18n.kinds[el.getAttribute('data-kind')] || el.getAttribute('data-kind') || '—';
    document.getElementById('planDetailDue').textContent = el.getAttribute('data-due') || '—';
    document.getElementById('planDetailStatus').textContent = i18n.status[el.getAttribute('data-status')] || el.getAttribute('data-status') || '—';
    var rem = el.getAttribute('data-remaining');
    document.getElementById('planDetailRemainingDt').classList.toggle('d-none', !rem);
    document.getElementById('planDetailRemainingDd').classList.toggle('d-none', !rem);
    if (rem) { document.getElementById('planDetailRemaining').textContent = rem; }
    $('#planDetailModal').modal('show');
  }
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.plan-detail-btn'), function (btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () { fillPlanDetail(btn); });
  });
  // Rev: a feeding row click opens the details; clicks on chips, expand
  // headers and apply buttons keep their own behavior. Enter/Space toggle
  // it for keyboard users (R3-4 language).
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.plan-feeding-row[data-detail]'), function (tr) {
    tr.addEventListener('click', function (ev) {
      if (ev.target.closest('a, button, [data-toggle], .plan-feed-header')) { return; }
      fillPlanDetail(tr);
    });
    tr.addEventListener('keydown', function (ev) {
      if (ev.key !== 'Enter' && ev.key !== ' ') { return; }
      if (ev.target.closest('a, button, [data-toggle], .plan-feed-header')) { return; }
      ev.preventDefault();
      fillPlanDetail(tr);
    });
  });

  // --- Batch apply (feeding group / cage rows) ------------------------------
  var batchBtn = null;
  function openBatch(btn) {
    var refs = JSON.parse(btn.getAttribute('data-items') || '[]');
    if (!refs.length) { return; }
    batchBtn = btn;
    var what = btn.getAttribute('data-food') || btn.getAttribute('data-source-name') || '';
    var summary = i18n.batchSummary
      .replace('{count}', refs.length)
      .replace('{cage}', btn.getAttribute('data-cage') || '')
      .replace('{what}', what);
    document.getElementById('planBatchSummary').textContent = summary;
    document.getElementById('planBatchError').classList.add('d-none');
    $('#planBatchModal').modal('show');
  }

  // §10.1-5/N2: a batch stays source×cage-scoped — one batch call per
  // source, sequentially, then one reload (bugs.md U1/U6).
  function runBatch(btn) {
    var refs = JSON.parse(btn.getAttribute('data-items') || '[]');
    if (!refs.length) { return; }
    var bySource = {};
    refs.forEach(function (r) {
      var k = r.source_type + '|' + r.source_id;
      (bySource[k] = bySource[k] || []).push(r);
    });
    var failures = [];
    var chain = Promise.resolve();
    Object.keys(bySource).forEach(function (k) {
      var items = bySource[k];
      chain = chain.then(function () {
        return track(fetch('/care_plan/apply_batch', {
          method: 'POST', credentials: 'same-origin',
          headers: {'Accept': 'application/json', 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRF-Token': csrf},
          body: JSON.stringify({items: items})
        }).then(function (r) {
          return r.json().then(function (j) {
            if (r.status !== 200) {
              failures.push((j && (j.detail || j.error)) || ('HTTP ' + r.status));
              return;
            }
            (j.results || []).forEach(function (it) {
              if (it.status === 'error') {
                failures.push(it.animal_id + ': ' + (it.error || ''));
              }
            });
          });
        }));
      });
    });
    return chain.then(function () { return failures; });
  }

  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.plan-feeding-apply, .plan-cage-apply'), function (btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () { openBatch(btn); });
  });

  document.getElementById('planBatchSubmit').addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (!batchBtn) { return; }
    var btn = batchBtn;
    this.disabled = true;
    var submitBtn = this;
    $('#planBatchModal').modal('hide');
    runBatch(btn).then(function (failures) {
      submitBtn.disabled = false;
      if (failures.length) {
        showMessage(i18n.errorTitle, failures.join('\n'));
      } else {
        // R3-2: no reload — flip the group's per-animal checks to their
        // undo controls and retire the global apply until the refresh.
        flipBatchRow(btn);
      }
    });
  });

  // flipBatchRow marks every applicable chip of the batch row as applied
  // (check → undo) and hides the exhausted global apply button.
  function flipBatchRow(btn) {
    var row = btn.closest('tr');
    if (!row) { window.location.reload(); return; }
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(row.querySelectorAll('.plan-feeding-one:not(.d-none), .plan-apply-btn:not(.d-none)'), function (b) {
      markApplied({btn: b});
    });
    btn.classList.add('d-none');
  }

  // --- History: late-record a superseded occurrence (§6.2-2, A1) ------------
  // R5-2c/S9: the history late-record button REUSES the apply modal for
  // input kinds (observation → answer, weighing → weight, §10-L1): a
  // blind confirm-POST would 4xx ("answer is required"). openApply marks
  // the ref late (plan-late-btn class) so the submit records after the
  // fact (bypasses only the apply-window 409).
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.plan-late-btn'), function (btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      if (isInputKind(btn.getAttribute('data-kind'))) { openApply(btn); return; }
      if (!window.confirm(lateConfirm)) { return; }
      fetch('/care_plan/apply', {
        method: 'POST', credentials: 'same-origin',
        headers: {'Accept': 'application/json', 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRF-Token': csrf},
        body: JSON.stringify({
          source_type: btn.getAttribute('data-source-type'),
          source_id: btn.getAttribute('data-source-id'),
          animal_id: parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-animal-id'), 10),
          due_at: btn.getAttribute('data-due-at'),
          late: true
        })
      }).then(function (r) {
        if (r.status === 201) { window.location.reload(); return; }
        r.json().then(function (j) {
          showMessage(i18n.errorTitle, (j && (j.detail || j.error)) || ('HTTP ' + r.status));
        });
      });
    });
  });

  // --- History: free undo (A8) ----------------------------------------------
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.plan-history-undo'), function (btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      fetch('/care_plan/unapply', {
        method: 'POST', credentials: 'same-origin',
        headers: {'Accept': 'application/json', 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRF-Token': csrf},
        body: JSON.stringify({
          source_type: btn.getAttribute('data-source-type'),
          source_id: btn.getAttribute('data-source-id'),
          animal_id: parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-animal-id'), 10),
          due_at: btn.getAttribute('data-due-at'),
          delete_fulfillment: true
        })
      }).then(function (r) {
        if (r.status === 200) { window.location.reload(); return; }
        r.json().then(function (j) {
          showMessage(i18n.errorTitle, (j && (j.detail || j.error)) || ('HTTP ' + r.status));
        });
      });
    });
  });

  // Zone dropdown memory (bugs.md U3): the legacy feeding screen remembered
  // its tab in location.hash — replicate with a z- prefix so the tier
  // anchors (#tier-*) never collide. A remembered zone only applies when
  // the URL carries no explicit ?zone= filter.
  var zoneTabs = document.querySelectorAll('#planZoneMenu a[data-zone]');
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(zoneTabs, function (tab) {
    tab.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var z = tab.getAttribute('data-zone');
      try { history.replaceState(null, '', z ? '#z-' + z : window.location.pathname + window.location.search); }
      catch (e) { /* older browsers: ignore */ }
    });
  });
  var zoneParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('zone');
  if (!zoneParam && window.location.hash.indexOf('#z-') === 0) {
    var remembered = decodeURIComponent(window.location.hash.substring(3));
    var match = null;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(zoneTabs, function (tab) {
      if (tab.getAttribute('data-zone') === remembered) { match = tab; }
    });
    if (match) { window.location.replace(match.getAttribute('href')); }
  }
})();"
